stage_info.name: 2d_optimization
stage_info.description: 2D classification optimization stage: Iteratively refine particle selection using 2D classification and CryoSift until 90% good particles are achieved

2d_optimization.enable_function1_iterative_description: Enable Function 1: Iterative 2D classification until 90% good particles (default: true)
2d_optimization.enable_function2_rescue_description: Enable Function 2: Rescue good particles from excluded set (default: true)
2d_optimization.max_iterative_rounds_description: Maximum number of iterative rounds for Function 1 (default: 5)
2d_optimization.enable_select_all_after_last_round_descr: If enabled, after the last round of 2D classification, run a select_2d job to select all particles from that round (default: false)
2d_optimization.stop_on_quality_degradation_description: If enabled, stop iterative 2D classification rounds when quality degrades (median cryosift score increases). Lower scores are better, so if median score increases, quality is degrading (default: true)

2d_classification.num_classes_description: Number of 2D classes to generate for each classification round
2d_classification.force_max_description: Force max over poses/shifts when aligning particles to references. If True, maximize over poses and shifts. If False, marginalize over poses and shifts to account for alignment uncertainty. Default: False (recommended for better results with small or low SNR particles, or when using fewer classes)
2d_classification.batchsize_per_class_description: Number of particles per class to use during each iteration of online-EM. For small or low SNR particles, this can be increased to 200. Default: 200

select_2d_classes.cryosift_threshold_description: CryoSift confidence threshold (1-5). Classes scoring BELOW this value are selected
select_2d_classes.cryosift_env_description: Conda environment used to run CryoSift evaluation
select_2d_classes.cryosift_weights_path_description: Path to the CryoSift neural network weights file
select_2d_classes.cryosift_evaluator_script_path_descripti: Path to the CryoSift evaluator script (output_class_list.py)
select_2d_classes.cryosift_output_subdir_description: Subdirectory where CryoSift outputs will be written
select_2d_classes.cryosift_fallback_strategy_description: Fallback behaviour if CryoSift evaluation fails
